topic: Cheech: early users shape the app (try it on Google Play)
caption:
The best roadmap for a new app comes from the people using it. 🚗

Cheech, the ride-sharing app we built, is live on Google Play, with iOS on its way to the App Store. That makes now the most useful time for feedback.

Why early feedback matters so much:

▸ It shows what people actually use, not what we guessed
▸ Small fixes early are cheaper than big fixes later
▸ It shapes what's ready by the time iOS launches

We follow the same approach on every product we build: ship, listen, improve.

On Android? Search “Cheech” on Google Play, take it for a spin and tell us what you think in the comments. 👇

Share this with a friend who's always looking for a ride. 🔁
